claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_environmental_temperature_immunity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The encoded half traces cleanly, but the item's second clause is deterministic environmental protection against extreme cold for both the wearer and worn/carried gear, which is not expressible as damage reduction, resistance, or any existing surface atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower
